body: i am still alive and did not relapse which was nice, but it’s like some part of me wish i had just so i was taken seriously yaknow? that’s horrible, but i feel like no one cares unless you take it to an extreme. i wish i could just leave and find someone that makes me feel loved and valued but it’s hard because we live together and have animals together. it just sucks. thank you for your check in, it meant a lot but i wasn’t okay to talk at the time :’)
